notes.title: New Evil Tonight Gameplay Video!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=uWtTEvmhLxw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, everyone!

We have uploaded a [b]new video[/b] showcasing some [b]core gameplay elements[/b] of our upcoming new game, [b][i]Evil Tonight[/i][/b]. It's just the tip of the iceberg! The project is still on the works, but it's also about to end. We just need to finish all cutscenes and boss battles, and translate all the texts into [b]10 different languages[/b]. Regarding release, we're targeting [b]this summer[/b], but if we need to delay the release date for polishing purposes, we'll let you know.

We hope you like what you see! If you're interested in this game, please, [b]add [i]Evil Tonight[/i] to your wishlist[/b], so that you don't miss our usual launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480830/

Best regards!

[url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/strikey-sisters-switch]https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/strikey-sisters-switch[/url]

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Accessibility
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33444235/494724bb1539987adc8ce2dc8963fd9f42afd105.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Viviette [b]1.0.5[/b] is now live, and a new "[b]Accessibility[/b]" option has been included. If enabled, the musical puzzle will provide visual feedback. We have also included [b]new text clues[/b] for some puzzles and fixed minor bugs.

Keep writing your impressions of the game in reviews, that helps much more than you think!

Thanks for playing and for supporting this game!

notes.title: v1.0.4 - Musical puzzle adjustments
notes.notes:
Hello!

In order to make the [b]musical puzzle[/b] more accesible, we have made some tweaks in [b]v1.0.4[/b]:

- The melody sounds a bit slower.
- The musical instrument sounds clearer.
- The number of notes to memorize depends on the difficulty mode.
- The pattern complexity depends on game difficulty (this only applies to new games).

We hope that helps!

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: v1.0.3 - More bug fixes and tweaks
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have just uploaded [b]v1.0.3[/b], which simply fixes some bugs and adds minor adjustments regarding puzzle clues and difficulty.

[b]1.0.3[/b] - [i]23/10/2018[/i]
- Added more colored text clues in some puzzles.
- Fixed movement bugs in crows.
- Melody puzzle complexity now depends on game difficulty.

As always, if you find serious bugs, just post them in our [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/1/]support forum[/url] and we'll fix them as soon as possible.

Thanks!

notes.title: v1.0.2 - Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello again!

This is another hot-fix that should solve several issues with the [b]enemy AI[/b], among other things.

[b]1.0.2[/b] - [i]21/10/2018[/i]
- Improved enemy AI.
- Fixed movement bugs in enemy AI.
- Fixed bug when opening doors at the same time.
- Fixed possible bug on left bathroom.

This update should make the game quite stable, with no game breaking issues. So, all next updates, if any, won't come that fast. Anyway, if you find serious bugs again, let us know in the forums and we will fix them as soon as possible.

Thanks!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: v1.0.1 - Fixed Japanese translation issues
notes.notes:
Hello!

[b]v1.0.1[/b] is a hot-fix to solve [b]Japanese translation errors[/b]. There was an error in some item description (the "Maestro" key) and the places where it should be used. If you find more translation issues, please, let us know as soon as possible. We'll fix them immediately. Sorry for the inconveniences.

We have also [b]tweaked some enemy AI parameters[/b]. Now its base speed is a bit lower, and there is more delay between detection and attack. We're also revising [b]enemy movement issues[/b], and other things, but those changes will take some time.

Meanwhile, just a reminder that writing [b]reviews[/b] with your impressions of the game, even if they're short, will help us reach a larger audience.

Thanks for playing!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Viviette is available NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As you can see, our new game [b][i]Viviette[/i][/b] is available now! We hope you like this hand crafted exploration adventure, and also the horror side of the experience. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoilers before playing. Long long time ago we had this idea floating around our heads, and just this year we decided to make it a reality. And this is the result!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018137/f8c01d882ac3b853c17600acdbd02369af08e220.jpg[/img]

As we have mentioned before, this is a [b]classic horror[/b] game where you'll have to [b]explore[/b] and solve some [b]puzzles[/b]. In adversity, you should persevere. We really encourage solving everything by yourselves. But if you need any help, we're sure other players will assist you in the game's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussion forums[/url].

That's all we have to say, to be honest. Just enjoy the experience!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]

notes.title: Viviette Release Date: 18 October 2018
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our upcoming new game, [b]Viviette[/b], now has an official release date:

[h1]18 October 2018[/h1]

Well, that's next week, on Thursday!

Viviette is an [b]exploration-puzzle[/b] game with touches of [b]classic horror[/b]. We highly recommend avoiding any kind of spoliers before playing the game, so that you can enjoy the full experience your own way. We think the game is super immersive from start to end.

In adversity, you should persevere. But if you get stuck in the game, just ask for help in the project's [url=steamcommunity.com/app/883070/discussions/]discussions forum[/url]. We won't reply, but surely other players will do. We will only reply to bug reports or technical issues, though we think the game is bug free.

Meanwhile, adding it to your [b]wishlist[/b] will help with visibility before launch:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/883070/Viviette/

Thanks for reading!

[i]Alberto & Dani[/i]
